svg.text: Single-page model • all 31 structures and all ownership/reference relationships retained • selected key attributes

Pale solid connectors: users 1 → many private documents (weightHistory has at most one state document per user). Green solid: embedded data. Blue dashed: logical identifier/provenance association. Gold dotted: derived summary/index.
ID denotes the document path key. Private collections are nested beneath users/{uid}; they are not independent public tables. Green cards are embedded maps or array entries, not separate collections.

Cardinalities are shown at reference/embedding endpoints. References from quests and achievements can point to a guided record OR a wearable award. Historical references and immutable receipts may remain after source deletion.

This is a logical NoSQL model, not SQL foreign-key enforcement. Key fields are shown; the full field dictionary remains the detailed specification. Health Connect caches and recommendation state stored only on-device are outside this cloud ERD.
